svg.title: Deployment: plan, delivery and recovery
svg.desc: Review applications, middleware, variables and capacity before delivering verified artifacts. Startup or health failures use available recovery information; recovery can also fail and must be reported. Restoring images/configuration does not undo migrations or external business effects.
svg.metadata: flowchart TB A["scan: discover project and required services"] B["Optional plan: preview target and changes"] C["build: prepare images, package and checksums"] D["deploy: transfer, verify and apply target configuration"] E["Start services; run health checks"] F["Persist successful release information"] X["Restore from recovery information; report both outcomes"] A --> B B --> C C --> D D --> E E -->|"healthy"| F D -->|"delivery fails"| X E -->|"startup / health fails"| X classDef default fill:#edf3ff,stroke:#476aab,color:#172b4d,stroke-width:1.5px; classDef good fill:#e9f6ef,stroke:#28734e,color:#17452f,stroke-width:1.5px; classDef stop fill:#fff0f0,stroke:#af4040,color:#742b2b,stroke-width:1.5px; classDef pending fill:#fff6df,stroke:#a07827,color:#654b18,stroke-width:1.5px; class F good; class X pending;

text.font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC,Noto Sans CJK JP,sans-serif
